summary.zh_hans: 一家中国海水淡化厂通过将废弃卤水转化为工业用盐，能耗减少约六成，成为降低淡化成本及推动绿色发展的重要突破。该技术化废为宝，在减少排放的同时降低运营成本。
summary.zh_hant: 一家中國海水化淡廠透過將廢棄鹵水轉化為工業用鹽，能耗減少約六成，成為降低化淡成本及推動綠色發展的重要突破。該技術化廢為寶，在減少排放的同時降低營運成本。

title.en: Four-vehicle crash including three buses on Tsing Kwai Highway disrupts airport-bound traffic
title.zh_hans: 葵涌青葵公路4车相撞包括3部巴士　往机场方向交通受阻
title.zh_hant: 葵涌青葵公路4車相撞包括3部巴士　往機場方向交通受阻

summary.en: Four vehicles, including three buses, collided on Tsing Kwai Highway in Kwai Chung, disrupting traffic in the airport-bound direction. At least one person was injured in the crash.
summary.zh_hans: 葵涌青葵公路发生4车相撞意外，包括3部巴士，往机场方向交通受阻。意外中至少一人受伤。
summary.zh_hant: 葵涌青葵公路發生4車相撞意外，包括3部巴士，往機場方向交通受阻。意外中至少一人受傷。

title.en: Shares in Malaysia's Genting tumble by the most in 28 years
title.zh_hans: 马来西亚云顶集团股价急泻　创28年来最大跌幅
title.zh_hant: 馬來西亞雲頂集團股價急瀉　創28年來最大跌幅

summary.en: Shares in Malaysian conglomerate Genting fell by their largest margin in 28 years, a major development for the regional gaming and hospitality giant. The plunge marks one of the sharpest single-day sell-offs in the group's history.
summary.zh_hans: 马来西亚综合企业云顶集团股价急泻，录得28年来最大单日跌幅。这间博彩及酒店业巨头的股价重挫，成为区内商界重大事件。
summary.zh_hant: 馬來西亞綜合企業雲頂集團股價急瀉，錄得28年來最大單日跌幅。這間博彩及酒店業巨頭的股價重挫，成為區內商界重大事件。

title.en: Saudi capital's airport hit by fresh Houthi strike a day after deadly attack
title.zh_hans: 沙特首都机场再遭胡塞袭击　距致命空袭仅隔一日
title.zh_hant: 沙特首都機場再遭胡塞襲擊　距致命空襲僅隔一日

summary.en: Riyadh's main airport was hit by another Houthi strike on Monday, just a day after an attack that killed 12 people. The Houthis said their military campaign would continue until Saudi Arabia stops its own strikes, raising fears of further escalation in the region.
summary.zh_hans: 沙特首都利雅得主要机场周一再遭胡塞武装袭击，距上一次造成12人死亡的空袭仅隔一天。胡塞方面称，除非沙特停止自身军事打击，否则行动将持续，外界忧虑地区局势进一步升级。
summary.zh_hant: 沙特首都利雅得主要機場周一再遭胡塞武裝襲擊，距上一次造成12人死亡的空襲僅隔一天。胡塞方面稱，除非沙特停止自身軍事打擊，否則行動將持續，外界憂慮地區局勢進一步升級。

title.en: China sanctions foreign ministers of Taiwan's diplomatic allies Paraguay and Belize in first-ever move
title.zh_hans: 史上首次　中国宣布制裁台湾邦交国巴拉圭、伯利兹外长
title.zh_hant: 史上首次　中國宣布制裁台灣邦交國巴拉圭、伯利茲外長

summary.en: Beijing announced sanctions against the foreign ministers of Paraguay and Belize, two of Taiwan's remaining diplomatic allies — the first time mainland China has sanctioned senior officials of Taiwan's diplomatic partners. The move marks a sharp escalation in cross-strait diplomatic pressure.
summary.zh_hans: 北京宣布制裁台湾邦交国巴拉圭及伯利兹的外交部长，为大陆史上首次制裁台湾邦交国高官。此举被视为两岸外交战的重大升级。
summary.zh_hant: 北京宣布制裁台灣邦交國巴拉圭及伯利茲的外交部長，為大陸史上首次制裁台灣邦交國高官。此舉被視為兩岸外交戰的重大升級。

title.en: Three women arrested over apm mall fight; mainland defendant allowed to leave Hong Kong
title.zh_hans: apm三女子涉打架被捕　内地女被告获准离港不设附加条件
title.zh_hant: apm三女子涉打架被捕　內地女被告獲准離港不設附加條件

summary.en: Three women were arrested over an alleged fight at apm mall in Kwun Tong. A mainland Chinese defendant asked the court for permission to leave Hong Kong, and the magistrate granted it without additional bail conditions.
summary.zh_hans: 三名女子涉在观塘apm商场打架被捕。一名内地女被告向法庭申请离港，裁判官在没有附加保释条件下批准。
summary.zh_hant: 三名女子涉在觀塘apm商場打架被捕。一名內地女被告向法庭申請離港，裁判官在沒有附加保釋條件下批准。

title.en: 37-year-old suspected illegal worker found dead at Mai Po fish pond; hirer arrested
title.zh_hans: 米埔鱼塘黑工倒毙｜37岁冷气技工陈尸鱼塘　雇主涉雇用黑工被捕
title.zh_hant: 米埔魚塘黑工倒斃｜37歲冷氣技工陳屍魚塘　僱主涉僱用黑工被捕

summary.en: A 37-year-old air-conditioning technician, believed to be an illegal worker, was found dead at a fish pond in Mai Po. Police arrested the man who hired him on suspicion of employing illegal workers; neighbours said the deceased had been seen feeding fish by the pond.
summary.zh_hans: 一名37岁冷气技工在米埔鱼塘被发现倒毙，怀疑为非法劳工。警方拘捕涉案雇主，涉嫌雇用非法劳工。邻居表示曾见死者在鱼塘边喂鱼。
summary.zh_hant: 一名37歲冷氣技工在米埔魚塘被發現倒斃，懷疑為非法勞工。警方拘捕涉案僱主，涉嫌僱用非法勞工。鄰居表示曾見死者在魚塘邊餵魚。

title.en: Goldman Sachs: AI trade shifting from hardware to applications; market hungry for the 'next AI story'
title.zh_hans: 高盛：AI交易从硬件转向应用　市场迫切渴望「下一个AI故事」
title.zh_hant: 高盛：AI交易從硬件轉向應用　市場迫切渴望「下一個AI故事」

summary.en: Goldman Sachs strategists said in a recent macro podcast that the AI investment trade is shifting from hardware toward applications, with the market eagerly searching for the "next AI story". The comments reflect growing investor focus on monetising artificial intelligence.
summary.zh_hans: 高盛策略师在最新宏观播客中表示，AI投资交易正从硬件转向应用层面，市场迫切渴望寻找「下一个AI故事」。言论反映投资者日益关注人工智能的商业化变现。
summary.zh_hant: 高盛策略師在最新宏觀播客中表示，AI投資交易正從硬件轉向應用層面，市場迫切渴望尋找「下一個AI故事」。言論反映投資者日益關注人工智能的商業化變現。

title.en: Over 5,000 travellers use revamped Huanggang crossing in its first two hours
title.zh_hans: 新皇岗口岸开通首两小时　逾5000人次使用
title.zh_hant: 新皇崗口岸開通首兩小時　逾5000人次使用

summary.en: The rebuilt Huanggang border crossing opened smoothly on Monday morning, serving more than 5,000 travellers in its first two hours. Officials described the launch as satisfactory, with the new "cooperative inspection, single release" clearance model cutting crossing times from around 30 minutes to about five.
summary.zh_hans: 重建后的新皇岗口岸今早开通，首两小时已有逾5000人次使用，运作畅顺。口岸采用「合作查验、一次放行」新通关模式，将过关时间由原来约30分钟大幅缩短至约5分钟。
summary.zh_hant: 重建後的新皇崗口岸今早開通，首兩小時已有逾5000人次使用，運作暢順。口岸採用「合作查驗、一次放行」新通關模式，將過關時間由原來約30分鐘大幅縮短至約5分鐘。

title.en: Hong Kong's 'AI city brain' could begin testing in next typhoon season, says Eric Chan
title.zh_hans: 陈国基：香港「AI城市大脑」有望下个风季测试
title.zh_hant: 陳國基：本港「AI城市大腦」有望下個風季測試

summary.en: Hong Kong's planned "AI city brain" system could undergo testing during next year's typhoon season, Chief Secretary Eric Chan said. The platform aims to use artificial intelligence to coordinate emergency responses and strengthen the city's resilience against extreme weather.
summary.zh_hans: 政务司司长陈国基表示，香港计划中的「AI城市大脑」系统有望于下一个风季开始测试。该平台旨在运用人工智能协调应急反应，提升城市应对极端天气的能力。
summary.zh_hant: 政務司司長陳國基表示，本港計劃中的「AI城市大腦」系統有望於下一個風季開始測試。該平台旨在運用人工智能協調應急反應，提升城市應對極端天氣的能力。

title.en: China's CXMT unveils key progress on chip structure pursued by Samsung and SK Hynix
title.zh_hans: 长鑫存储芯片结构技术获关键进展　三星、SK海力士同路竞逐
title.zh_hant: 長鑫存儲晶片結構技術獲關鍵進展　三星、SK海力士同路競逐

summary.en: Chinese memory chipmaker CXMT has unveiled key progress on a chip structure technology that Samsung and SK Hynix are also pursuing, signalling a narrowing gap in the memory chip race. The advance underscores China's push to close the gap with global leaders in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary.zh_hans: 中国存储芯片厂商长鑫存储（CXMT）宣布在三星、SK海力士亦正攻关的芯片结构技术上取得关键进展，显示中外存储芯片技术差距正在收窄。这项进展凸显中国追赶全球半导体龙头的努力。
summary.zh_hant: 中國記憶體晶片廠商長鑫存儲（CXMT）宣布在三星、SK海力士亦正攻關的晶片結構技術上取得關鍵進展，顯示中外記憶體晶片技術差距正在收窄。這項進展凸顯中國追趕全球半導體龍頭的努力。

summary.en: The National Forestry and Grassland Administration released a five-year report card for China's first batch of national parks, saying ecosystems keep improving and flagship species such as Siberian tigers and Hainan gibbons have seen significant population growth.
summary.zh_hans: 国家林草局公布首批国家公园设立五年成果，生态环境持续改善，东北虎、海南长臂猿等标志性物种种群显著增长。
summary.zh_hant: 國家林草局公布首批國家公園設立五年成果，生態環境持續改善，東北虎、海南長臂猿等標誌性物種種群顯著增長。

title.en: China's first batch of national parks delivers five-year ecological report card
title.zh_hans: 首批国家公园交出五年生态答卷　标志性物种种群显著增长
title.zh_hant: 首批國家公園交出五年生態答卷　標誌性物種種群顯著增長

summary.en: The rebuilt Huanggang Port opened at 6:30am, implementing the new "joint inspection, one release" clearance model. Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki and security chief Tang Ping-keung inspected the operation and said it ran smoothly, with all immigration counters opened to let officers get familiar with the new flow.

summary.zh_hant: 重建後的新皇崗口岸今晨6時30分正式啟用，實施「合作查驗、一次放行」全新通關模式。政務司司長陳國基與保安局局長鄧炳強到場視察，稱整體運作暢順，已開放全部出入境櫃位，讓人員熟習運作。

title.en: New Huanggang Port officially opens with "joint inspection, one release" clearance; Chan Kwok-ki inspects operation

summary.en: A Sudanese civil society group said a gold mine in the North Wadi area near the Egyptian border was hit by a large-scale airstrike on 10 October, killing 72 miners. The statement accused the Egyptian air force; Egypt and Sudan have not responded. Sudan's civil war, now in its fourth year, has killed at least 59,000 people.

summary.en: HKUST president Nancy Ip said in an interview that the university's participation in the Northern Metropolis university town will focus on translating research outcomes into practical applications. She added that HKUST has recruited more than 160 outstanding scholars since 2022.
summary.zh_hans: 科大校长叶玉如接受专访时强调，科大参与北都大学城将着重科研成果转化。她表示，科大自2022年起已延聘逾160名优秀学者。

summary.en: Tim Cook made his first visit to China since stepping down as Apple CEO, saying Apple will step up its business in Guangdong. During the trip he visited Guangzhou, including the set of a Wing Chun-themed short film shot on the iPhone 18 Pro.
summary.zh_hans: 卸任苹果CEO后的库克首次访华，表示苹果将加码广东业务。期间他到访广州，包括探班一部以iPhone 18 Pro拍摄的咏春题材短片。
summary.zh_hant: 卸任蘋果CEO後的庫克首次訪華，表示蘋果將加碼廣東業務。期間他到訪廣州，包括探班一部以iPhone 18 Pro拍攝的詠春題材短片。

title.en: Tim Cook visits China for first time since stepping down as Apple CEO, pledges bigger Guangdong push

summary.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky responded to US President Donald Trump's suggestion that Ukraine should change its leader, saying the country's leader should be decided by the Ukrainian people. He said holding elections under wartime conditions would be extremely difficult, but one could be considered if Russia agreed to a 60-day ceasefire.
summary.zh_hans: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基回应美国总统特朗普有关乌克兰应更换领导人的言论，表示乌领导人应由乌克兰人民决定。他指在战争状态下举行选举极具困难，但若俄方同意停火60天，可考虑举办选举。
summary.zh_hant: 烏克蘭總統澤連斯基回應美國總統特朗普有關烏克蘭應更換領導人的言論，表示烏領導人應由烏克蘭人民決定。他指在戰爭狀態下舉行選舉極具困難，但若俄方同意停火60天，可考慮舉辦選舉。

title.en: Zelensky: Ukraine's leader should be chosen by Ukrainians; holding elections now is very difficult
title.zh_hans: 泽连斯基：乌克兰领导人应由乌国人民决定　现时举行选举很难
title.zh_hant: 澤連斯基：烏克蘭領導人應由烏國人民決定　現時舉行選舉很難

summary.en: US President Donald Trump said Russia and Ukraine have agreed to an energy ceasefire. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky responded that Ukraine would agree if Russia does. The exchange comes as US-Ukraine ties strain over Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries and Trump's remarks about a leadership change in Kyiv.
summary.zh_hans: 美国总统特朗普表示，俄罗斯和乌克兰已同意实施能源停火。乌克兰总统泽连斯基回应指，若俄方同意，乌方亦会同意。双方表态之际，美乌关系因乌军袭击俄炼油厂及特朗普有关更换乌领导人的言论而趋紧张。
summary.zh_hant: 美國總統特朗普表示，俄羅斯和烏克蘭已同意實施能源停火。烏克蘭總統澤連斯基回應指，若俄方同意，烏方亦會同意。雙方表態之際，美烏關係因烏軍襲擊俄煉油廠及特朗普有關更換烏領導人的言論而趨緊張。

title.en: Trump says Russia and Ukraine agree to energy ceasefire; Zelensky says Ukraine will agree if Russia does
title.zh_hans: 特朗普称俄乌同意能源停火　泽连斯基指若俄方同意乌方亦会同意
title.zh_hant: 特朗普稱俄烏同意能源停火　澤連斯基指若俄方同意烏方亦會同意

summary.en: A boat carrying 305 people capsized off the coast of Djibouti, killing at least 139 people including children, with 84 others still missing. Search and rescue operations are ongoing; the cause of the accident is under investigation.
summary.zh_hans: 一艘载有305人的船只在非洲吉布提沿海翻沉，至少139人死亡，包括儿童，另有84人仍然失踪。搜救工作仍在进行，事故原因有待调查。
summary.zh_hant: 一艘載有305人的船隻在非洲吉布提沿海翻沉，至少139人死亡，包括兒童，另有84人仍然失蹤。搜救工作仍在進行，事故原因有待調查。

title.en: Boat capsizes off Djibouti killing at least 139, dozens missing
